If IsActiveMember is a top driver, the first step is re-engagement rather than a discount. Offer a free financial health review, help the customer set up the mobile app, and switch on salary credit or auto-pay. Inactive customers who are re-engaged within 30 days are much less likely to leave. [sour

The threshold is chosen on validation data to maximise the expected profit of the retention campaign. Missing a churner costs more than an unnecessary offer, so the best threshold is usually lower than 0.5. [source: model_faq.md > Why is the threshold not 0.5]

The model is retrained when population stability index on any important feature exceeds 0.25, when the monthly PR-AUC on newly labelled data falls by more than 0.05, or every six months, whichever comes first. [source: model_faq.md > When is the model retrained]

Do not contact the same customer with a retention offer more than once in 90 days. Respect marketing opt-outs at all times; a service call about an account review is allowed, a promotional offer is not. [source: escalation_and_offers.md > Contact limits]

The probability is calibrated. A score of 0.30 means that among many customers with that score, about 30 out of 100 left the bank. It is not a certainty for any single customer. [source: model_faq.md > What does the churn probability mean]

When Balance is a top driver and the balance is high, the customer is valuable and may be moving money to a competitor offering a better rate. Escalate to the premium team, review the deposit rate, and consider a rate-match offer within the pricing authority limits. [source: retention_playbook.md >

If a flagged customer has an open complaint, resolve the complaint first. A retention offer made while a complaint is open is often seen as an attempt to buy silence. [source: escalation_and_offers.md > Complaints]

Customers holding three or four products churn at very high rates in our data. This usually signals product fatigue, overlapping fees or a bad cross-sell. Run a product rationalisation call: review every product, close or merge the ones the customer does not use, and waive the overlapping fees for 6

When Age is the main driver, customers are often approaching retirement and consolidating accounts. Offer a retirement planning session, pension transfer support and a senior relationship manager. Avoid generic promotional offers. [source: retention_playbook.md > Older customers]
